user.title: Import cards from CSV
user.description:
Paste rows from a spreadsheet, header line included. Columns: `owner`, `product` (name or catalog id), and optionally `issuer`, `role` (primary or au), `parent_owner` or `parent_last4` for authorized users, `open_date`, `fee_month`, `last4`, `nickname`, `annual_fee`, `notes`. Primary cards need an open date or fee month. Existing cards are skipped, never duplicated.

Example:
```
owner,issuer,product,role,parent_owner,fee_month,last4,annual_fee
Brian,Chase,Sapphire Reserve,primary,,February,1234,795
Nick,Chase,United Club,au,Brian,,,
```
